issue: New entry not persisted after page reload
actual: Created entry "Test Entry" appeared immediately (6 entries total), but after page reload, only 5 original entries remained. The new entry was lost.
evidence: Before reload: 6 entries including "Test Entry" with priority 5, due date Sep 1, 2026. After reload: 5 entries, "Test Entry" missing.
Successfully added field "Notes" with type "Text". Field type selector clearly shows all 4 options: Text, Number, Date, Checkbox. New field appears in table header, sort options, and field list.
Successfully switched from table to card view. All 5 entries remain present with identical data. Card view shows all fields including checkbox values (Yes/No display).

Successfully edited entry-1: changed Task Name (text) to "Design updated", Priority (number) to "10", Due Date (date) to "2026-02-20", Completed (checkbox) to Yes, and Notes (text) to "Test notes". All values saved and displayed consistently in both table and card views.
Sorted table by Priority (ascending), then switched to card view which showed no sort. Switched back to table view and Priority sort was preserved. Each view retains independent sort state.

Clicked Priority column header to sort. Entries immediately reordered from original order to sorted by Priority (1, 2, 2, 3, 10). Sort dropdown and status bar identified active field (Priority) and direction (ascending). App remained fully usable.

Searched for "Design" - returned 1 entry matching ("Design updated"). Status showed "1 entry matching \"Design\"". Cleared search - all 5 entries restored. Case-insensitive matching works. Result count updates correctly.

actual: Searched for filter-related elements (buttons, inputs, actions) and found none. Available actions are: open-field-config, sort-entries, switch-to-table-view, switch-to-card-view, add-entry, sort-by-column, edit-entry, delete-entry. No filter action or element exists.
No import button, menu option, or related text found in UI. Searched for "import" in page content and button labels - none found. Available actions do not include any import-related functionality.

evidence: Priority field uses HTML input[type="number"]. Attempting to type non-numeric value "abc" resulted in error "Cannot type text into input[type=number]". Number field inherently rejects non-numeric input at browser level.

Due Date field uses HTML input[type="date"]. Attempting to type invalid date "invalid-date" resulted in error "Malformed value". Date field inherently rejects invalid dates at browser level, only accepts YYYY-MM-DD format.

Before sort: 5 entries. After sorting by Task Name (ascending): still 5 entries. All field values preserved for each entry (e.g., entry-1: Design updated/10/Feb 20, 2026/Test notes). Only order changed, no data loss or modification.

issue: Completed field values not displayed in table view
actual: Card view displays Completed checkbox as Yes/No (e.g., entry-1 is Yes, entry-2 is Yes, entry-3 is No). Table view does not display Completed field column values at all. Same entry data should display identically in both views.
evidence: Card view collection includes field-4.value in display. Table view collection omits field-4 values entirely. Same entries should show same field values in both views.

Field type selector in Fields dialog displays 4 clearly labeled options: "Text", "Number", "Date", "Checkbox". Each option is clearly visible and selectable. Added "Notes" field with type "Text" - option was unambiguous and correctly applied.

Checkbox values displayed clearly as "Yes" (checked) and "No" (unchecked) in card view. Examples: entry-1 shows Yes, entry-2 shows Yes, entry-3 shows No, entry-4 shows No, entry-5 shows Yes. Clear visual/textual distinction between states.

issue: Search doesn't match formatted dates or checkbox states
actual: Search matches text ("Design" finds "Design updated") and numbers ("10" finds priority 10). But search does NOT match formatted dates (searching "Feb 20" returns 0 results even though entry-1 shows "Feb 20, 2026") or checkbox states (searching "Yes" returns 0 results even though entries show "Yes").
evidence: Requirement: match formatted values shown to users. Test results: "Design"✓, "10"✓, "Feb 20"✗, "Yes"✗

issue: Manual reordering via drag-and-drop not verified as functional
actual: Drag UI elements appear when no sort is active (drag handles visible, "reorder-entry" actions present in semantic hints). However, drag operations using Playwright's dragTo method did not result in visible reordering of entries. Unable to confirm the feature works as intended.
evidence: When sort is cleared, drag field appears in entries collection and "Drag entries to reorder" message shown. Attempted drag operations did not change entry order in subsequent snapshots.

actual: No filter UI, buttons, or actions found for field-specific filtering. Searched all semantic actions - none include "filter". The only filtering mechanism available is global text search (which is different from field-specific filtering). Field-specific filter criteria cannot be defined or applied.
evidence: No filter-related elements found in DOM. Available actions: open-field-config, sort-entries, switch-to-table-view, switch-to-card-view, add-entry, sort-by-column, edit-entry, delete-entry, reorder-entry. No filter action present.
